description: Wire email service into auth flows and notification system. lib/email.ts already exists with Resend integration and email templates (password reset, welcome, lead assignment, follow-up reminder). Currently emails are logged to console in dev. Wire into services/auth-service.ts requestPasswordReset() to call sendPasswordResetEmail(). Wire into employee creation to send welcome email. Add RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM to env. Install resend package.
steps: Add email env vars to .env.example: RESEND_API_KEY (optional), EMAIL_FROM='CRM <noreply@yourcompany.com>' with comments explaining Resend setup and console fallback in dev
Update lib/env.ts: add RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM to envSchema as optional strings

Update services/auth-service.ts requestPasswordReset(): after creating reset token, call await sendPasswordResetEmail(email, link) from lib/email.ts. Import { sendPasswordResetEmail } from '@/lib/email'. Remove the console.log/console.warn (email.ts handles that).
Update services/employee-service.ts or wherever new users are created: after user creation with temporary password, call await sendWelcomeEmail(user.email, user.name, tempPassword) from lib/email.ts

Create services/email-notification-service.ts: export async function sendNotificationEmail(userId: string, notification) that fetches user email and calls appropriate email template. Wire into automation rules that have EMAIL channel.
Update lib/email.ts: verify all email templates exist and are well-formatted (already implemented: sendPasswordResetEmail, sendWelcomeEmail, sendLeadAssignmentEmail, sendFollowUpReminderEmail)
Add email configuration page at app/(app)/settings/email/page.tsx for testing email delivery: form to send test email to current user
Write tests in tests/email.test.ts: mock Resend client, test email sending with valid/invalid config, test template rendering
Update DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md with Resend setup instructions: sign up, verify domain, get API key, add to production env
acceptance_criteria: Password reset emails are sent when configured (arrives in inbox within 1 minute)
Welcome emails sent to new users with login credentials
Email service gracefully degrades when not configured (logs to console in dev, warns in prod)
Test email page allows admins to verify email delivery
All email templates render correctly with proper HTML formatting
Email links (reset password, login) work correctly
verification: npm run test - email tests pass
Start app without RESEND_API_KEY - request password reset - verify email logged to console
Start app with valid RESEND_API_KEY and verified domain - request password reset - verify email arrives
Create new user - verify welcome email sent
Visit /settings/email - send test email - verify delivery
Click reset link in email - verify it works and redirects to reset page
